question: How do I place an order?
answer: Browse the products, add items to your cart, click Checkout, enter your delivery address and pay. You will get a confirmation email within minutes.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, popular wallets and cash on delivery for orders under Rs. 5000.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Go to My Orders and click Track Order, or use the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery takes 1-2 business days in major cities.

question: What are the delivery charges?
answer: Delivery is free on orders above Rs. 499. Below that, a flat fee of Rs. 49 applies.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Yes. You can cancel from My Orders any time before the item is shipped. After shipping, you can refuse delivery or return the item.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return most items within 15 days of delivery if they are unused and in original packaging.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: Open My Orders, select the item, click Return, choose a reason and schedule a pickup. Our courier will collect it from your address.

question: How long does a refund take?
answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item. The money goes back to your original payment method.

question: What if I received a damaged or wrong item?
answer: Sorry about that! Report it within 48 hours from My Orders with a photo, and we will send a replacement or a full refund.

question: Do you offer warranty on products?
answer: Electronics come with a manufacturer warranty of 1 year. The warranty details are on the product page and in your invoice.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up at the top right, enter your name, email and password, then verify your email with the code we send.

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page, enter your registered email and follow the reset link we send you.

question: How do I change my delivery address?
answer: Go to My Account, then Addresses, and edit or add a new address. For an order already placed, contact support before it ships.

question: Do you have any discounts or coupons?
answer: Yes! Subscribe to our newsletter for a welcome coupon, and check the Offers page for current deals and seasonal sales.

question: How do I apply a coupon code?
answer: At checkout, enter your code in the Apply Coupon box and click Apply. The discount shows in your order summary.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Currently we deliver only within India. International shipping is planned for the future.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: Email support@shopeasy.example or call 1800-123-456 from 9 AM to 9 PM, Monday to Saturday. You can also use the live chat on our website.

question: Is my payment information safe?
answer: Yes. All payments are encrypted and processed through secure, PCI-compliant gateways. We never store your full card details.

question: Can I change or modify my order after placing it?
answer: You can change the size, color or quantity before the order ships by contacting support. After shipping, changes are not possible.

question: Do you have a mobile app?
answer: Yes, the ShopEasy app is available for Android and iOS. Download it from the Play Store or App Store for app-only offers.
